text: futility of futilities! Everything is futile!
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: Behold, I have grown and increased in wisdom beyond all those before me who were over Jerusalem, and my mind has observed a wealth of wisdom and knowledge.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: Come now, I will test you with pleasure; enjoy what is good!
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: The fate of the fool will also befall me. What then have I gained by being wise?
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: God will judge the righteous and the wicked, since there is a time for every activity and every deed.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: As for the sons of men, God tests them so that they may see for themselves that they are but beasts.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: I have discovered this by adding one thing to another to find an explanation.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: While my soul was still searching but not finding, among a thousand I have found one upright man, but among all these I have not found one such woman.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: Only this have I found: I have discovered that God made men upright, but they have sought out many schemes.
name: The Teacher

speaker: teacher
text: Wisdom is better than strength, but the wisdom of the poor man is despised, and his words are not heeded.
name: The Teacher
